scope: Independent implementation and production-runtime audit of all 49 boss mechanics. No source/module edits performed by this audit.
result: PASS: 49 distinct boss-mechanic checks plus 9 shared/secondary checks; all 58 passed.

resolved_findings.resolution: Shield break now invalidates the current hit pipeline ward/barrier snapshots and boss ring budget.
Skeleton uses collision-safe placement at the defeated enemy instead of spawning around the caster.
resolved_findings.verified_by: lich conversion spawns skeleton at corpse not at caster

initial_evidence.reason: Moving orbit destination was faster than allowed flight speed; source did not reach far side.

resolved_findings.resolution: Closer acquisition, feasible orbital speed and longer orbit; damage per pulse reduced to preserve total scheduled pulse budget.
resolved_findings.verified_by: emberwing orbits and repeated rain damages current target

untested_boundaries.exact_test_to_add: Surround every rear-center teleport candidate with large same-layer bodies; assert success=false, no overlap or arena escape, and no second infiltration attempt.
For each area ability, put cap+2 legal high-HP targets in range and one out of range; assert unique hit count at the documented per-cast/per-pulse cap and that the out-of-range target is untouched.
Fill each team to 64 living / 256 historical records and total to 512; invoke slime/golem/lich spawn paths and assert no overrun, no duplicated tokens, and deterministic failure.
Place multiple shell/silver/ring defenders around one ally, queue same-tick lethal defender damage and multiple incoming hits, and assert deterministic attribution and no duplicated interception.

limitations: Primary tests run actual combatStep and its real hit/status/movement/spawn pipeline. Most casts are invoked inside that pipeline with opposing attacks held, to isolate the distinctive effect. Emberwing, rhino and cleaver additionally run natural acquisition/cooldown scheduling.

The separate 66-check integration suite verifies auto activation, determinism, mirrored battles, production step parity, no-target handling, death hooks and replay event/flag roundtrips. It is smoke and invariance evidence, not a replacement for the 49 mechanic-specific assertions.

Numeric values are tuned implementation limits, not claims about unrestricted visual concepts. Airborne is a timed action lock plus presentation, not a change from ground to air target layer. Phase uses a bounded collision-safe relocation. Swallowing is represented by backline selection, pull and a capped finisher.
This audit does not measure balance, rendering quality or every cross-roster interaction. It does not claim exhaustive state-space coverage.
